cohort: The cohort consisted of all women who delivered in a specific tertiary center during both the first and second waves of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Mothers experienced more severe COVID-19 disease during the second wave (increased oxygen requirement and ICU admission) compared to the first, but this did not significantly increase maternal mortality or overall poor neonatal outcomes, except for an increase in neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the mode of deliveries between the first and second waves of COVID-19.
